dedupe_keys.name: webtris traffic flow and journey time data for the strategic road network national highways

description: WebTRIS is National Highways' service for historic traffic flow, speed and journey time data from count sites on the strategic road network in England. Its API lists 20,076 sites from the MIDAS, TAME, TMU and legacy TRADS systems, grouped into 25 areas, and offers traffic reports for each site. WebTRIS replaced the older TRADS service in 2016. Coverage is national for the motorways and major A roads. The data are free under the Open Government Licence, readable through the web interface and the REST API, and listed on data.gov.uk; National Highways also runs an open data services site with further layers such as emergency areas. Caveats: the site notes that updates are paused in September 2026 during an infrastructure change, while historic data remain accessible, and site coverage varies with detector availability. The counts support calibration of traffic assignment models, disruption and resilience studies on trunk roads and capacity planning. They complement the National Highways network model and the DfT road traffic counts catalogued here.
